scenarios.name: host_wait_revoke_recover_submit_once
scenarios.title: Host launch waits -> revoke -> explicit launch -> trusted input -> revoke queued/layout/history work -> resume -> one submit -> guarded file upload -> stop
scenarios.workflow: Launch -> observe -> edit -> withdraw -> refuse -> restore -> submit -> verify -> stop
scenarios.user_problem: A human operation waiting on the browser must not use withdrawn permissions or be resent after recovery.

steps.description: Exercise real Worker HTTP, Chrome input and server receipt plus held streaming upload

scenarios.name: extension_host_wait_revoke_recover_submit_once
scenarios.title: Connect existing extension -> trusted input -> revoke pending effects -> refuse -> recover on same browser -> one submit -> disconnect
scenarios.workflow: Connect -> observe -> edit -> withdraw -> refuse -> restore -> submit -> disconnect
scenarios.user_problem: Personal Chrome must enforce the same host assertion without replacing the browser or replaying a rejected input.

steps.description: Run production extension connection and managed Worker in a fresh correctly configured process; verify trusted input and one real HTTP receipt
